title: Raw run record, cp-raw-record/1
description: What one run of a per-system harness writes: one instance of one sub-problem, in one configuration and one mode. The same schema for every system. Fields are defined in harnesses/README.md, 'The raw record'. A value the harness cannot read is null, never guessed; why it is null may be said in the nearest 'notes'. validate.py checks this schema and the further rules listed in harnesses/README.md.

made_up.description: true only in records written by hand to test validate.py (harnesses/examples/). A harness never writes it, or writes false.

effects.description: P11 only: the effects log as it stands after this run, and the entries this run appended. null for every other problem.

manual_actions.description: Actions by a person, outside the fixed harness, during this run, that apply to no single stage. Per-stage actions are in the stage.

harness_faults.description: Anything the harness itself failed to do (could not read a quantity, could not parse an answer, a crash of the harness rather than the system), verbatim. Empty if none.

run_id.description: unique; also the stem of the record's file name

problem.description: P01-P16; X00-X99 only in made-up records

parameters.description: the instance's parameters, copied from harnesses/stages.json

purpose.description: primary: a result run on the program's own constants; variant: the verifier's run on hidden constants; qualification: a harness test on a made-up program; example: a made-up record

how.description: block: a marked constants block inside the program; input: read from a file the harness passes; none: the sub-problem has no constants

variant.description: the hidden variant's id when run by the verifier, else null

commit.description: the pinned commit of the system as run (PINS.md), e.g. read from /opt/src/COMMITS

image.description: the container image digest or id the harness ran in

binary.description: the path of the executable run

version_output.description: the system's own version report, verbatim

instrumented.description: true when the build or the run carries the systems file's measurement instrumentation

dirty.description: the harness files differed from the commit when the run was made

command.description: the harness command line, as invoked

posing.description: how the configuration receives a stage after the first, from its systems file ('The same computation')

complete.description: every stage of the instance was posed and recorded

confounds.description: anything this harness does beyond passing stages in, collecting answers and reading state, as listed in its README

environment.description: environment variables the harness set for the system (PYTHONHASHSEED, for instance)

attempts.description: the first attempt under the safety limit, and the one rerun under the raised limit if the first was stopped by it. The stage's result is the last attempt's; both are kept.

print.description: the output of print(), verbatim: the system's own rendering of what it holds

wall_time_s.description: wall-clock time of the attempt, for the safety limit only; not a metric

cpu_time_s.description: process CPU time; P13 growth only

max_rss_kb.description: the operating system's maximum resident set size of the process; P13 growth only, from a run without the store instrumentation

stdout.description: verbatim, everything the system and program wrote to standard output during the attempt

status.description: the exit status of the system's process at the end of the attempt, or null where the process keeps running into the next stage

action.description: rerun: a second attempt follows under the raised limit; final-timeout: the rerun also stopped; fixed-limit-timeout: the problem fixes the limit (P12, P13, P16), so no rerun

how_stopped.description: how the harness stopped the system (signal, engine abort), verbatim

effects.description: P11: the effects log entries appended during this attempt, in order. Empty array for every other problem.

separate_run.description: where collecting answers or observing would consume the computation the next stage extends (PROTOCOL.md, 'Observing must not consume the computation'): the separate run of stages 1 to k on which they were taken. null otherwise.

how.description: fresh: stage 1 into a new computation; incremental: stage k into the computation that holds stages 1 to k-1; reposed: stages 1 to k replayed in order into a new computation

reason.description: why the stage was posed this way

replayed.description: the earlier stages replayed before this one, in order: [] unless reposed, and then exactly 1..k-1

replayed_commitments.description: P11: each replayed commit stage, and the value v it was replayed as (x = v), verbatim as first selected

selected_in_run.description: run_id of the run whose commit stage selected v (this run's own id if it was selected earlier in this run)

continued_after_budget.description: the previous stage ended in budget and this stage was posed into that same computation with a new budget

instance_parameters_passed.description: what the harness told the program about the instance (n, order, answers), verbatim

id.description: 'main', or the computation's name in harnesses/stages.json

spawned.description: started with spawn() in this stage

spawn_index.description: 1 for the first spawn() call of the stage, 2 for the second, ...

side_by_side.description: for a spawned computation: spawn() returned at once and it ran beside the others (true), or the configuration ran it to its end or budget before the next (false)

problem_operations.description: applications of each case of each relation the problem defines, as counted by the program's counters or the systems file's instrumentation, by name ('conc/1' for conc's case 1, for instance); null where not counted

candidates_examined.description: P12: sequences s for which accept(s) was evaluated, as counted

verbatim.description: the answer exactly as the system's standard mechanism for answers produced it

steps_at.description: steps of the stage when the answer was produced (cost mode)

alternatives_at.description: retained alternatives when the answer was produced, before the next was requested (storage mode, or wherever exact)

ended_by.description: why answers(cap) returned; no-enumeration: the configuration has no mechanism for further answers (the program prints what it computed and stops)

states.description: SPECIFICATION.md, Execution state, as far as the harness can tell it mechanically after answers(); 'alternatives pending' and 'suspended' may both hold

determined.description: false where the harness cannot tell the state mechanically; states then lists what it could tell, possibly nothing, and the classifiers decide

basis.description: what the harness read to decide: the budget mechanism's signal, the system's own report of open choicepoints or suspended goals, exit status, ...

error_verbatim.description: the system's error, verbatim, when states includes error

budget.description: the budget this computation had for this stage: budget_steps, plus the restart cost if reposed

budget_enforced.description: false where the configuration has no step count to enforce a budget by (ALGOL 60 x1sim, behaviour only); then only the safety limit stops the run, and budget_exhausted is false. Absent means true

stage.description: incremental cost: steps from the end of stage k-1 to the end of stage k, where the computation was received incrementally

restated.description: restated cost: steps from nothing to the end of stage k, in this run

restart_cost.description: for a reposed stage: the measured steps of the replay of stages 1 to k-1, in the system's step unit; null only for a stage that is not reposed, or where budget_enforced is false

restart_cost_method.description: in-run: the step count read when stage k was first posed in this reposed run; separate-run: a run of stages 1 to k-1 alone, without answers(), measured before it. Required for a reposed stage with a restart cost

restart_cost_source.description: where restart_cost was measured: this run and stage, or the separate run's description

repeated_work.description: from the source the systems file names (Absys trace; ALGOL 60 name_repeat_evaluations), by quantity; null where the systems file says it is not measured

unit.description: the systems file's unit of an alternative

held_as.description: whether the alternatives are all live at once or kept for backtracking, as the systems file says

problem_defined.description: problem-defined alternatives (METRICS.md), by name, as counted by the program or instrumentation; null if not counted

items.description: suspended or waiting work by kind, in the system's own terms (susp_equations, attributed variables, ...), at the stage boundary

kind.description: sampled: a sampled maximum, never called a peak in results

sample_interval.description: for a sampled maximum: the interval, with its unit

quantities.description: the systems file's store vector, by quantity name; {} where not measured in this mode

raw.description: the state observe() read at the end of the stage, verbatim, as the system gave it (including at the moment a budget ran out)

method.description: how it was read: which system facility, command or call

bindings.description: the bindings held, by unknown, each as the system rendered it, verbatim; null where the raw state is not split by unknown mechanically

effects_log.description: P11: the observation log it wrote to, which is not judged

seq.description: position in the log, which is never reset

entry.description: the argument of emit, verbatim as the stub received it

stage.description: the stage being posed when emit was called

during_replay_of.description: the earlier stage being replayed when emit was called, in a reposed run; null when emitted while posing the stage itself. Entries with a value are candidates for 'duplicated only by reposing'; the classifiers decide

log_path.description: the classification log of this configuration and instance

observation_log_path.description: the log written by separate observation runs and by cost and storage runs; not judged

log_after_run.description: the whole classification log after this run, in order, verbatim
